name: io.github.shatch/banjo
title: Banjo
description: Self-hosted AI assistant that places real phone calls for you: bookings, reservations, errands.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: "Bearer " followed by the MCP_API_KEY you gave the server.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection URL. Migrations run on boot.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token MCP clients must send (at least 32 characters, e.g. openssl rand -hex 32).

environmentVariables.name: ASSISTANT_PRINCIPAL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: The name of the person Banjo calls on behalf of.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_HOSTNAME
environmentVariables.description: Public hostname Twilio reaches this server on (no scheme), e.g. a tunnel or reverse proxy.

environmentVariables.name: VOICE_AI_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Voice AI vendor. openai is the one carrying live traffic.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key, for VOICE_AI_PROVIDER=openai or openai-live.

environmentVariables.name: TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: The Twilio number Banjo calls from, in E.164 (+15551234567).

environmentVariables.name: NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: How Banjo tells you a call's outcome. twilio_sms also needs NOTIFY_TO_PHONE_NUMBER and NOTIFY_FROM_PHONE_NUMBER; pushover needs PUSHOVER_APP_TOKEN and PUSHOVER_USER_KEY.
